info.name: Simple Bank Backend API
info.description: Simple Bank API on MongoDB Atlas with JWT and role-based access. Fill customerUsername, customerPassword, adminUsername, and adminPassword locally from docs/demo-credentials.txt. Do not commit live passwords. Authentication > Admin Login stores adminToken and jwtToken. Staff folders use Bearer {{jwtToken}}. Authentication > Customer Login stores customerToken only. A customer token cannot list users or call /admin/whoami. Public registration creates CUSTOMER, never the reserved username admin.
